steps.en: Install and start the Flowise server (Node.js ≥ 20)
steps.zh: 装好并启动 Flowise 服务（Node.js ≥ 20）
steps.code: npm install -g flowise · npx flowise start

steps.en: On the canvas, drag in a chat model, tools or a document loader, connect them, add API keys
steps.zh: 在画布上拖入聊天模型、工具或文档加载器，连线并填好密钥

steps.en: Saves the graph as a chatflow and lets you chat with it in the test panel
steps.zh: 把这张图存成 chatflow，并在测试面板里让你直接对话

steps.en: Call the saved chatflow from your app over HTTP
steps.zh: 在你的应用里通过 HTTP 调用这个 chatflow

steps.en: Rebuilds the node graph, calls the model and tools, keeps chat history, returns the answer
steps.zh: 重建节点图，调用模型和工具，保存对话历史，返回答案

value.en: A document Q&A bot or tool-using agent behind an HTTP endpoint without hand-written wiring; since 2026-08 every patch is yours
value.zh: 不手写串联代码，就得到一个挂在 HTTP 接口后的文档问答或工具型 agent；但 2026-08 起补丁都归你

sources: https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise#quick-start (npm install -g flowise, npx flowise start, http://localhost:3000, NodeJS >= 20)
https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise/tree/main/packages/components/nodes (chatmodels, tools, documentloaders, vectorstores, agentflow node folders)
